status.description: Outcome: applied, requeued (a new turn was enqueued), rejected, unsupported, discarded, or taken.

newRunId.description: New run id when the decision re-enqueues a turn (rerun_with_feedback).

newJobId.description: Accepted job handle of the re-enqueued work, present even before its run binds.

taskGroupId.description: Caller-generated UUID saved before launching the first member. Each job still needs its own idempotency key; the group grants no execution authority.

storeId.description: Identity of the durable engine store that accepted this command, stable across restarts. A group member always carries it; an ordinary receipt carries it only for a request sending `X-Claudexor-Store-Identity: 1`, and it stays absent, meaning unknown, when the store has no identity to give.

ControlRunDecisionResponse.description: Response to an operator run decision.
